Category: Vehicle.
Subject: futuristic militarized truck from 2077.
Style: low-poly cyberpunk, extremely intricate.

spec.name: Warhound X-77 Armored Hauler
spec.description: A low-poly cyberpunk 2077 militarized six-wheel armored truck with angular plated hull, armored cab, roof turret, neon trim and a cargo bay with cargo pods.
spec.layout: Long, low, wedge-shaped six-wheeled heavy truck facing +Z. Front: sloped armored bumper with plow blade and light bar at z=4.2. Cab (z 1.6..3.6) is an angular wedge with a slit tinted windshield, side armor skirts and roof sensor mast. Behind the cab, a flat armored cargo bay (z -4.0..1.4) with ribbed containers, rear ramp door and roof rails. A turret ring sits on the roof just behind the cab with twin cannons pointing +Z. Three axles of chunky low-poly wheels with hubs rest on the floor (front axle z=2.9, rear tandem z=-1.6 and z=-3.2). The chassis frame sits between wheels with exposed undercarriage, exhausts and fuel tanks. Style: faceted dark gunmetal plates, hazard yellow stripes, magenta and cyan neon underglow lines, glowing lamps and screens, tiny greeble parts (vents, bolts, antennas, decals) on every surface.

parts.builds: Undercarriage and frame: two long ladder rails, cross members, differentials on three axles, drive shafts, axle housings, leaf/air suspension arms, twin fuel tanks and side exhaust stacks in steel and black, battery boxes, cyan and magenta underglow strips along the sides, mudflaps, skid plates, tow hooks, bolt rows and hazard stripe trim on the rails. Joints: body only (axle housings and suspension are rigid on body).
parts.attaches: Top face at chassisTop height y=1.2 carries cab and cargo; axle housings end at wheel mounts frontAxle, rearAxle1, rearAxle2 where wheel hubs begin.

parts.builds: Six chunky low-poly wheels (radius 0.65, width 0.55): faceted rubber tires with tread block parts, steel rims with lug nuts, glowing cyan hub rings, armored hubcap domes, brake discs and calipers visible, and a hazard-yellow sidewall stripe. Each wheel rides its own wheel joint, axle along x.
parts.attaches: Centred on the axle mounts frontAxle, rearAxle1, rearAxle2 at x=+-1.3; hub centres at y=0.65.

parts.builds: Armored wedge cab and front end: sloped hull plates, slit tinted windshield glass with cyan HUD glow, side windows with armor shutters, roof sensor mast with antennas and dish, light bar with lamp parts, sloped armored bumper with plow blade, hazard stripes, headlamps and red taillike running lights, door seams and handles, side armor skirts over the front wheel arches, wheel arch fenders, vents, exhaust, decal emblem and unit numbers as small parts, mirrors with cameras. Colours hull, hullLight, armor, glass, hazard, lamp, neonCyan.
parts.attaches: Sits on cabFloor/chassisTop; rear wall at z=1.4 meets cargo front wall; roof top y=2.55 near turretRing; bumper at bumperFront.

parts.builds: Armored cargo bay behind the cab: slab-sided container with paneled plating, ribbing, vents, hatches, roof rails, stacked cargo pods and crates strapped on top, glowing magenta and cyan neon trim lines, hazard-striped rear ramp door on rampDoor joint with hinges and lock bars, rear tail lights, side fenders over rear tandem wheels with mud flaps, ammo lockers, antenna array, fuel cap and tiny serial decals. Colours hull, hullDark, armor, hazard, neonMagenta, orange.
parts.attaches: Floor at cargoFloor y=1.2 on chassis; front wall touches cab at z=1.4; rear door hinge at rearDoor mount; roof y up to 3.0 stays behind the turretRing zone (z>0.4 reserved for turret).

parts.builds: Roof-mounted remote weapon station: ring base with teeth and bearing, rotating armored turret housing (faceted, on turretYaw), twin barrel cannons on gunPitch with muzzle brakes, heat-shield sleeves, ammo box with belt, sensor eye with glowing red lens, camera pod, missile pod with four tubes on one side, small antenna, hazard stripe, neon red accent lines and bolts. Colours gunmetal, hullLight, steel, neonRed, hazard, black.
parts.attaches: Ring base sits on the roof at mount turretRing (0,2.55,1.2); housing on turretYaw, barrels on gunPitch pointing +Z.

calls.reasoning:
I'm planning a compact cab-building function with a box helper for geometry, color, and rotation, then sketching out the cab's dimensions and bone attachment.

I'm working out the geometry: wheel placement, cab body width constraints so wheels tuck under fenders, and sloped hood/windshield plates using rotation math around the X axis to tilt fronts downward.

Now I'm planning the full parts list to generate: main block, hood, windshield frame and glass, HUD glow, side windows with shutters, mast, dish, antennas, light bar, bumper, plow blade, hazard stripes, headlamps, running lights, door seams, handles, skirts, fenders, vents, exhaust, emblem, numbers, and mirrors, using a loop to mirror the side components.

Writing plow and bumper geometry...
